en.name: Junru Lu
en.description: Junru Lu is a Foundation Model Researcher at Tencent YouTu Lab, working on foundation-model pre-training and architecture, efficient long-context modeling, and memory for long-horizon agents.
en.hero_bio: Core R&D member of YouTu's LLM and MLLM team. Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Warwick, advised by Prof. Yulan He.
en.open_models_intro: Weights and code for Youtu-LLM and Youtu-VL

en.career_summary: As a core member of YouTu's LLM and MLLM R&D team, I explore large-scale distributed pre-training of 2B, 4B and 30B-A3B LLMs and 32B-A4B, 120B-A7B and 640B-A31B MoE MLLMs. The largest model has 640B total parameters and about 31B active.

career_responsibilities.label: Data
career_responsibilities.text: Built text and multimodal pre-training pipelines for quality filtering, deduplication, contamination detection and data synthesis. Text corpus: 20TB+; multimodal corpus: 5TB+.

career_responsibilities.label: Architecture
career_responsibilities.text: Made architecture design decisions across scales, Dense/MoE and unimodal/multimodal models, including new sparse-attention and native multimodal architectures.

career_responsibilities.label: Infrastructure
career_responsibilities.text: Contributed to fused attention, routing, multimodal packing and FP8 distributed embedding kernels, and co-designed the new LightningMoBA kernels.

career_responsibilities.label: Training
career_responsibilities.text: Explored large-scale distributed pre-training of 2B/4B/30B-A3B LLMs and 32B-A4B/120B-A7B/640B-A31B MoE MLLMs, and built monitoring for downstream metrics, model health and training stability.

career_responsibilities.label: Evaluation
career_responsibilities.text: Built automated inference validation and text/multimodal/long-context/agentic evaluation and reporting pipelines, and designed new evaluation benchmarks.

en.career_intro: Core R&D across model design, pre-training and evaluation.

career_highlights.label: Data
career_highlights.text: 20TB+ text / 5TB+ multimodal data, quality control and synthesis.

career_highlights.label: Design
career_highlights.text: Dense/MoE decisions, sparse attention and native multimodal modeling.

career_highlights.label: Infra
career_highlights.text: Fused-kernel R&D and co-design of the new LightningMoBA kernels.

career_highlights.label: Training
career_highlights.text: Large-scale pre-training, downstream metrics, model health and stability.

career_highlights.label: Evaluation
career_highlights.text: Automated text, multimodal, long-context and agentic evaluation.

en.notes_intro: Earlier notes on NLP, question answering, algorithms, and learning.
en.footer_topics: Foundation models · Efficient attention · Agent memory

career_responsibilities.label: 数据
career_responsibilities.text: 建设文本与多模态预训练数据管线，负责质量过滤、去重、污染检测和数据合成。文本语料20TB+，多模态语料5TB+。

career_responsibilities.label: 架构
career_responsibilities.text: 决策不同规模的Dense/MoE、单模态/多模态架构设计，包括稀疏注意力、原生多模态等创新结构研发。

career_responsibilities.label: Infra
career_responsibilities.text: 参与研发融合注意力、路由、多模态打包及FP8分布式嵌入等算子，co-design新版LightningMoBA算子。

career_responsibilities.label: 训练
career_responsibilities.text: 探索2B/4B/30B-A3B LLM及32B-A4B/120B-A7B/640B-A31B MoE MLLM的大规模分布式预训练，构建下游指标、模型健康度和训练稳定性的多维度监控。

career_responsibilities.label: 测试
career_responsibilities.text: 搭建自动化推理验证、文本/多模态/长上下文/Agentic评测与汇总管线，同时设计创新的评测基准。
